empty.title: Start with one place you keep money.

bank.account_already_linked: This local account is already linked to another provider account. Add a new account or select an unlinked account.
bank.cancelled: Operation cancelled. Credential locked. If token claim had begun, revoke it at SimpleFIN before reconnecting.
bank.claim_failure: The setup token could not be claimed. It may already have been used or compromised; revoke it at SimpleFIN and obtain a new token.
bank.failure: The operation failed or passkey verification was cancelled. No automatic retry will occur. Verify your passkey, connectivity and account mappings.
bank.invalid_setup_token: This setup token is invalid or uses an unsupported SimpleFIN address. Paste the complete setup token from SimpleFIN Bridge. No provider request was made and the token has not been claimed.
bank.locked: Locked. Each action requires your original passkey.
bank.locking_unavailable: This browser cannot coordinate bank operations across tabs. Use a browser that supports Web Locks.
bank.manual_only: Transactions are fetched only when you press Sync now. Each provider operation requires passkey verification.
bank.mapping_failure: A mapped account is archived, unavailable or ambiguous. Discover accounts and map each provider account to an active local account, then retry manually.
bank.mode_mismatch: This workspace has a bank connection from the other mode. Select a dedicated workspace for this mode, or restart the app with the matching demo setting. The existing connection has not been replaced.
bank.other_tab: A bank operation is already running in another tab. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
bank.partial_success: Sync completed with some records omitted or provider errors. Credential locked.
bank.passkey_failure: Passkey encryption could not be verified. Your setup token has not been claimed. Use a compatible browser and password manager.
bank.passkey_help: First create a passkey. We will then explain two separate tests: encrypting a harmless sample and unlocking it again. Your SimpleFIN token is claimed only after both tests pass and you choose to save the connection.
bank.provider_failure: SimpleFIN could not complete the request. Check connectivity or reauthorize your accounts at SimpleFIN, then retry manually.
bank.recovery: Reconnect with a new setup token and passkey. Imported data and mappings remain. Disconnect also requires revoking access at SimpleFIN to invalidate previously copied credentials.
bank.restricted: Select a workspace where you are an owner or admin to manage your own bank connection.
bank.result_time_outcome_imported_existing_om: Last sync: {time}. Outcome: {outcome}. Imported: {imported}; already present: {existing}; omitted: {omitted}.
bank.save_failure: The token was consumed but the encrypted connection was not saved. Revoke this connection at SimpleFIN and reconnect with a new token.
bank.setup_creating_body: Choose your password manager and approve passkey creation. This passkey will protect your SimpleFIN connection. Your setup token has not been claimed.
bank.setup_encrypt_body: Your passkey was created. Next, use it to encrypt a harmless sample. This checks encryption support without using your SimpleFIN token.
bank.setup_encrypt_waiting: Approve the passkey prompt to encrypt the sample. Your setup token has not been claimed.
bank.setup_offline: Bank sync setup is not available offline. Connect to the internet to continue.
bank.setup_save_body: Both tests passed. Continue to claim your one-use SimpleFIN token, encrypt the credential and save the connection. This step does not fetch accounts or transactions.
bank.setup_saving_body: Claiming your SimpleFIN token and saving the encrypted credential. The connection will be locked when setup finishes.
bank.setup_verify_body: The sample is encrypted. Use the same passkey again to confirm it can unlock the sample. This separate check proves the connection can be recovered later.
bank.setup_verify_waiting: Approve the passkey prompt to unlock the sample. Your setup token has not been claimed.
bank.sync_offline: Sync is not available offline. Connect to the internet to sync your bank transactions.
bank.title: Bank sync
bank.unlock_failure: Your original passkey could not unlock this credential, verification was cancelled, or the encrypted record is invalid. No provider request was made. Try a compatible browser and password manager, or reconnect if the passkey is lost.
bank.waiting: Waiting for encrypted credentials to replicate, or reconnection is required.
bank.working: Waiting for passkey verification or completing your requested operation…
